questions: When linear_regression=True, should the function still sort the data by sort_key before fitting the model, or should it fit the model on the original unsorted data?
If linear_regression=True and output_path is also provided, should the function still write the sorted data to the output file, or should it only return the model and ignore output_path?
If linear_regression=True, are x_column and y_column required arguments, and if they are None, should the function raise an error or use default columns?
Should the sorting be done in ascending order only, or should the function support specifying ascending/descending order?
If the sort_key column contains duplicate values, should the function preserve the original order (stable sort) or is any order acceptable?
Should the function handle missing values in the sort_key column or in x_column/y_column for linear regression, and if so, how (e.g., drop, fill, error)?
If linear_regression=False and output_path is provided, should the function return the output_path as a string or perhaps the DataFrame after saving?
Should the function read the CSV with any specific pandas options (e.g., encoding, delimiter, handling of quotes) beyond the default?
